::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** <i>June</i> 17<i>th</i>, 1896.  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne.  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown.  Printed in the supplement to the <i>Musical Herald</i> (1 August 1896), iv.
:::

[Sir](people/person_2407.qmd)-
Being unfortunately absolutely unmusical I am afraid I can say nothing to the purpose, except that I heartily congratulate you and the pupils of the College on lending glory and beauty to Divine service.
Yours truly
C. M. Yonge

---

**Note:** Along with a number of other public figures CMY had been asked by Curwen, the editor of the *Musical Herald*, to endorse the work of the Tonic Sol-fa College, which promoted the use of that system in the teaching of singing.
